entries.title: Psalms 119:1
segments: ALEPH. Blessed [are] the upright in the way, who walk in the law of the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 119:2
segments: Blessed [are] they who keep His testimonies, and who seek Him with all the heart.

entries.title: Psalms 119:3
segments: They also do no iniquity; they walk in His ways.

entries.title: Psalms 119:4
segments: You have commanded [us] to keep Your commandments carefully.

entries.title: Psalms 119:5
segments: O that my ways were fixed to keep Your statutes!

entries.title: Psalms 119:6
segments: Then I shall not be ashamed, when I have respect to all Your commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:7
segments: I will praise You with uprightness of heart when I have learned Your righteous judgments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:8
segments: I will keep Your statutes; do not forsake me completely.

entries.title: Psalms 119:9
segments: BETH. With what shall a young man cleanse his way? By taking heed according to Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:10
segments: With all my heart I have sought You; do not let me wander from Your commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:11
segments: I have hidden Your word in my heart, so that I might not sin against You.

entries.title: Psalms 119:12
segments: Blessed [are] You, O LORD; teach me Your statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:13
segments: With my lips I have declared all the judgments of Your mouth.

entries.title: Psalms 119:14
segments: I have rejoiced in the way of Your testimonies, [as much as] in all riches.

entries.title: Psalms 119:15
segments: I will think on Your commandments and have respect to Your ways.

entries.title: Psalms 119:16
segments: I will delight myself in Your statutes; I will not forget Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:17
segments: GIMEL. Deal bountifully with Your servant, [that] I may live and keep Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:18
segments: Open my eyes, so that I may behold wonderful things out of Your law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:19
segments: I [am] a stranger in the earth; do not hide Your commandments from me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:20
segments: My soul breaks for the longing that it has to Your judgments at all times.

entries.title: Psalms 119:21
segments: You have rebuked the proud [who are] cursed, who go astray from Your commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:22
segments: Remove cursing and scorn from me; for I have kept Your testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 119:23
segments: Princes also sat and spoke against me; [but] Your servant thought on Your statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:24
segments: Your testimonies also [are] my delight [and] my advisers.

entries.title: Psalms 119:25
segments: DALETH. My soul clings to the dust; give me life according to Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:26
segments: I have declared my ways, and You hear me; teach me Your statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:27
segments: Make me to understand the way of Your commandments, and I will speak of Your wonderful works.

entries.title: Psalms 119:28
segments: My soul weeps [for] grief; strengthen me according to Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:29
segments: Remove from me the way of lying; and grant me Your law graciously.

entries.title: Psalms 119:30
segments: I have chosen the way of truth; I have laid Your judgments [before me].

entries.title: Psalms 119:31
segments: I have stuck to Your testimonies; O LORD, do not put me to shame.

entries.title: Psalms 119:32
segments: I will run the way of Your commandments, when You shall enlarge my heart.

entries.title: Psalms 119:33
segments: HE. O LORD, teach me the way of Your statutes, and I shall keep it [to] the end.

entries.title: Psalms 119:34
segments: Give me understanding, and I shall keep Your law; yea, I shall observe it with all [my] heart.

entries.title: Psalms 119:35
segments: Cause me to walk in the path of Your commandments; for I delight in them.

entries.title: Psalms 119:36
segments: Bow my heart to Your testimonies, and not to unjust gain.

entries.title: Psalms 119:37
segments: Turn away my eyes from seeing vanity; in Your way give me life.

entries.title: Psalms 119:38
segments: Make Your word sure to Your servant, who [is devoted] to Your fear.

entries.title: Psalms 119:39
segments: Turn away my shame which I fear; for Your judgments [are] good.

entries.title: Psalms 119:40
segments: Behold, I have longed after Your commandments; in Your righteousness give me life.

entries.title: Psalms 119:41
segments: VAU. Let Your mercies come to me, O LORD, even according to Your salvation, according to Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:42
segments: And I shall have something to answer him who mocks me; for I trust in Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:43
segments: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in Your judgments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:44
segments: And I shall keep Your law continually forever and ever.

entries.title: Psalms 119:45
segments: And I will always walk in a broad place; for I seek Your commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:46
segments: I will speak of Your testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.

entries.title: Psalms 119:47
segments: And I will delight myself in Your commandments, which I have loved.

entries.title: Psalms 119:48
segments: And I will lift up my hands to Your commandments which I have loved; and I will think on Your statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:49
segments: ZAYIN. Remember the word to Your servant, on which You have caused me to hope.

entries.title: Psalms 119:50
segments: This [is] my comfort in my affliction; for Your word has given me life.

entries.title: Psalms 119:51
segments: The proud have utterly scorned me; yet I have not turned aside from Your law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:52
segments: I remembered Your judgments of old, O LORD, and have comforted myself.

entries.title: Psalms 119:53
segments: Horror has taken hold on me because of the wicked who forsake Your law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:54
segments: Your statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.

entries.title: Psalms 119:55
segments: I have remembered Your name, O LORD, in the night, and have kept Your law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:56
segments: This was done to me, because I kept Your commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:57
segments: CHETH. [You are] my portion, O LORD; I have said that I would keep Your words.

entries.title: Psalms 119:58
segments: I looked for Your favor with all [my] heart; be merciful to me according to Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:59
segments: I thought on my ways, and turned my feet to Your testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 119:60
segments: I made haste and did not delay to keep Your commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:61
segments: The bands of the wicked have robbed me; [but] I have not forgotten Your law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:62
segments: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to You because of Your righteous judgments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:63
segments: I [am] a companion of all who fear You, and of those who keep Your commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:64
segments: O LORD, the earth is full of Your mercy; teach me Your statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:65
segments: TETH. You have dealt well with Your servant, O LORD, according to Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:66
segments: Teach me good judgment and knowledge; for I have believed Your commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:67
segments: Before I was afflicted I went astray; but now I have kept Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:68
segments: You [are] good, and do good; teach me Your statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:69
segments: The proud have forged a lie against me; I will keep Your commandments with all [my] heart.

entries.title: Psalms 119:70
segments: Their heart is without feeling, like fat; [but] I delight in Your law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:71
segments: [It is] good for me that I have been afflicted, so that I might learn Your statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:72
segments: The law of Your mouth [is] better to me than thousands of gold and silver.

entries.title: Psalms 119:73
segments: JOD. Your hands have made me and formed me; give me understanding so that I may learn Your commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:74
segments: They who fear You will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:75
segments: I know, O LORD, that Your judgments [are] right, and that You have afflicted me in faithfulness.

entries.title: Psalms 119:76
segments: I beseech You, let Your merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to Your word to Your servant.

entries.title: Psalms 119:77
segments: Let Your tender mercies come to me so that I may live; for Your law [is] my delight.

entries.title: Psalms 119:78
segments: Let the proud be ashamed; for they perverted my cause with lying; I will think on Your commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:79
segments: Let those who fear You turn to me, and those who have known Your testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 119:80
segments: Let my heart be sound in Your statutes, so that I may not be ashamed.

entries.title: Psalms 119:81
segments: KAPH. My soul faints for Your salvation; I hope in Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:82
segments: My eyes fail for Your word, saying, When will You comfort me?

entries.title: Psalms 119:83
segments: For I am like a wineskin in the smoke; I do not forget Your statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:84
segments: How many [are] the days of Your servant? When will You carry out judgment on my persecutors?

entries.title: Psalms 119:85
segments: The proud have dug pits for me, which [are] not according to Your law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:86
segments: All Your commandments [are] faithful; they persecute me [with] lying; help me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:87
segments: They had almost finished me on earth; but I did not forsake Your commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:88
segments: According to Your loving-kindness give me life; so shall I keep the testimony of Your mouth.

entries.title: Psalms 119:89
segments: LAMED. Forever, O LORD, Your word is settled in the heavens.

entries.title: Psalms 119:90
segments: Your faithfulness [is] to all generations; You have founded the earth, and it remains.

entries.title: Psalms 119:91
segments: They stand to this day according to Your ordinances; for all [are] Your servants.

entries.title: Psalms 119:92
segments: Unless Your law [had been] my delight, I should then have perished in my affliction.

entries.title: Psalms 119:93
segments: I will never forget Your commandments; for with them You have given me life.

entries.title: Psalms 119:94
segments: I [am] Yours, save me; for I have sought Your commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:95
segments: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me; [but] I will think on Your testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 119:96
segments: I have seen an end to all perfection; Your commandment [is] exceedingly broad.

entries.title: Psalms 119:97
segments: MEM. Oh how I love Your law! It [is] my meditation all the day.

entries.title: Psalms 119:98
segments: Through Your commandments You make me wiser than my enemies, for they [are] ever with me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:99
segments: I have more understanding than all my teachers; for Your testimonies [are] my prayer.

entries.title: Psalms 119:100
segments: I understand more than the old men, because I keep Your commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:101
segments: I have kept my feet from every evil way, so that I might keep Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:102
segments: I have not departed from Your judgments; for You have taught me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:103
segments: How sweet are Your words to my taste! More than honey to my mouth!

entries.title: Psalms 119:104
segments: Through Your commandments I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way.

entries.title: Psalms 119:105
segments: NUN. Your word [is] a lamp to my feet, and a light to my path.

entries.title: Psalms 119:106
segments: I have sworn, and I raised [it], that I will keep Your righteous judgments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:107
segments: I am afflicted very much; O LORD, give me life according to Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:108
segments: I pray You, take the free-will offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me Your judgments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:109
segments: My life [is] in my hand daily; yet I do not forget Your law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:110
segments: The wicked have laid a snare for me; yet I do not go astray from Your commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:111
segments: I have taken Your testimonies as an inheritance forever; for they [are] the rejoicing of my heart.

entries.title: Psalms 119:112
segments: I have bowed down my heart to do Your statutes always to the end.

entries.title: Psalms 119:113
segments: SAMECH. I hate half-hearted [thoughts]; but Your law do I love.

entries.title: Psalms 119:114
segments: You [are] my hiding-place and my shield; I hope in Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:115
segments: Depart from me, you evil-doers, for I will keep the commandments of my God.

entries.title: Psalms 119:116
segments: Uphold me according to Your word, that I may live; and let me not be ashamed of my hope.

entries.title: Psalms 119:117
segments: Hold me up, and I shall be safe; and I will always have respect to Your statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:118
segments: You have trampled all those who go astray from Your statutes; for their deceit [is] falsehood.

entries.title: Psalms 119:119
segments: You put away all the wicked of the earth [like] waste; therefore I love Your testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 119:120
segments: My flesh trembles in fear of You; and I am afraid of Your judgments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:121
segments: AYIN. I have done the just and right [thing]; leave me not to those who crush me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:122
segments: Be surety for Your servant for good; let not the proud press me down.

entries.title: Psalms 119:123
segments: My eyes fail for Your salvation, and for the word of Your righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 119:124
segments: Deal with Your servant according to Your mercy, and teach me Your statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:125
segments: I [am] Your servant; give me understanding, that I may know Your testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 119:126
segments: [It is] time for the LORD to work; for they have broken Your law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:127
segments: Therefore I love Your commandments above gold; yea, even fine gold.

entries.title: Psalms 119:128
segments: Therefore I count all [Your] commandments concerning all things to be right; I hate every false way.

entries.title: Psalms 119:129
segments: PE. Your testimonies [are] wonderful; therefore my soul keeps them.

entries.title: Psalms 119:130
segments: The entrance of Your words gives light; it gives understanding to the simple.

entries.title: Psalms 119:131
segments: I opened my mouth and panted; for I longed for Your commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:132
segments: Look on me, and be merciful to me, as You usually do to those who love Your name.

entries.title: Psalms 119:133
segments: Order my steps in Your word; and do not let any iniquity rule over me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:134
segments: Deliver me from the oppression of man; and I will keep Your commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:135
segments: Make Your face shine on Your servant; and teach me Your statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:136
segments: Rivers of water run down my eyes, because they do not keep Your law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:137
segments: TZADDI. You are righteous, O LORD, and Your judgments [are] right.

entries.title: Psalms 119:138
segments: In Your testimonies You have commanded righteousness and faithfulness exceedingly.

entries.title: Psalms 119:139
segments: My zeal has eaten me up, because my enemies have forgotten Your words.

entries.title: Psalms 119:140
segments: Your word [is] very pure; therefore Your servant loves it.

entries.title: Psalms 119:141
segments: I [am] small and despised; [yet] I do not forget Your commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:142
segments: Your righteousness [is] an everlasting righteousness, and Your law [is] the truth.

entries.title: Psalms 119:143
segments: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me; [yet] Your commandments [are] my delight.

entries.title: Psalms 119:144
segments: The righteousness of Your testimonies [is] everlasting; give me understanding, and I shall live.

entries.title: Psalms 119:145
segments: QOPH. I cried with [my] whole heart; hear me, O LORD; I will keep Your statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:146
segments: I cried to You; save me, and I shall keep Your testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 119:147
segments: I went before the dawning of the morning and cried; I hoped in Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:148
segments: My eyes go before the [night] watches, so that I might think on Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:149
segments: Hear my voice according to Your loving-kindness; O LORD, according to Your judgment give me life.

entries.title: Psalms 119:150
segments: They draw near, those who follow after wickedness; they are far from Your law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:151
segments: You [are] near, O LORD, and all Your commandments [are] truth.

entries.title: Psalms 119:152
segments: Concerning Your testimonies, I have known of old that You have founded them forever.

entries.title: Psalms 119:153
segments: RESH. Look on my affliction, and deliver me; for I do not forget Your law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:154
segments: Plead my cause, and deliver me; according to Your word give me life.

entries.title: Psalms 119:155
segments: Salvation [is] far from the wicked, for they do not seek Your statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:156
segments: Great [are] Your tender mercies, O LORD; according to Your judgments give me life.

entries.title: Psalms 119:157
segments: Many [are] my persecutors and my enemies, yet I do not turn aside from Your testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 119:158
segments: I saw the traitors, and was grieved because they did not keep Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:159
segments: See how I love Your commandments; O LORD, according to Your loving-kindness give me life.

entries.title: Psalms 119:160
segments: Your word [is] true from the beginning; and every one of Your righteous judgments [endures] forever.

entries.title: Psalms 119:161
segments: SHIN. Princes have persecuted me without a cause, but my heart stands in fear of Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:162
segments: I rejoice at Your word, as one who finds great spoil.

entries.title: Psalms 119:163
segments: I hate and despise lying; [but] I love Your law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:164
segments: I praise You seven [times] a day because of Your righteous judgments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:165
segments: Great peace [is to] those who love Your law, and [there is] no stumbling block for them.

entries.title: Psalms 119:166
segments: LORD, I have hoped for Your salvation, and have done Your commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:167
segments: My soul has kept Your testimonies; and I love them very much.

entries.title: Psalms 119:168
segments: I have kept Your commandments and Your testimonies; for all my ways [are] before You.

entries.title: Psalms 119:169
segments: TAU. Let my cry come near to You, O LORD; give me wisdom according to Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:170
segments: Let my prayer come before You; deliver me according to Your word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:171
segments: My lips shall utter praise, when You have taught me Your statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:172
segments: My tongue shall speak Your word, for all Your commandments [are] righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 119:173
segments: Let Your hand help me; for I have chosen Your precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:174
segments: I have longed for Your salvation, O LORD; and Your law [is] my delight.

entries.title: Psalms 119:175
segments: Let my soul live, and it shall praise You; and let Your judgments help me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:176
segments: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek Your servant; for I do not forget Your commandments.
